description: This file defines the CalendarInstanceRepository interface for managing CalendarInstance entities, including methods for querying and cache management within the Fineract project.

classes.name: CalendarInstanceRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for CalendarInstance entities, providing methods for retrieval, counting, and cache management.

methods.name: findByCalendarIdAndEntityIdAndEntityTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves a CalendarInstance based on calendar ID, entity ID, and entity type ID with caching.

methods.name: findByEntityIdAndEntityTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves CalendarInstances by entity ID and type with caching.

methods.name: findByEntityIdAndEntityTypeIdAndCalendarTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves a CalendarInstance by entity ID, type, and calendar type with caching.

methods.name: findCalendarInstanceByEntityId
methods.description: Finds a CalendarInstance by entity ID and type with caching.

methods.name: findByCalendarIdAndEntityTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves CalendarInstances by calendar ID and entity type with caching.

methods.name: findCalendarInstancesForLoansByGroupIdAndClientIdAndStatuses
methods.description: Finds CalendarInstances for loans filtered by group ID, client ID, and loan statuses with caching.

methods.name: countOfLoansSyncedWithCalendar
methods.description: Counts loans associated with a calendar and specific statuses with caching.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a CalendarInstance and clears cache.

methods.name: saveAll
methods.description: Saves multiple CalendarInstances and clears cache.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CalendarInstance and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a CalendarInstance by ID and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all CalendarInstances and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteAll (overloaded)
methods.description: Deletes multiple CalendarInstances and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteAllById
methods.description: Deletes CalendarInstances by IDs and clears cache.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves and flushes a CalendarInstance, clearing cache.
